description: Address semantic review findings: (1) Fix reply icon opacity divisor from 56.0 to 36.0 to match new trigger threshold, (2) Incorporate OS accessibility text scale preference as a dampened multiplier in app.dart, (3) Clamp ZendScale.of() to (0.85, 1.3) to prevent extreme scaling on tablets.
steps: In zendapp/lib/src/features/dm/dm_message_bubble.dart line 409, change `(_swipeDx / 56.0)` to `(_swipeDx / 36.0)` so icon reaches full opacity when the haptic fires.

In zendapp/lib/app.dart (around line 521-523), incorporate OS accessibility preference: get osScale from MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(1.0), compute combined = (widthScale * osScale).clamp(0.85, 1.35), use TextScaler.linear(combined).
In zendapp/lib/src/design/zend_tokens.dart, clamp ZendScale.of() result to (0.85, 1.3) and update the docstring to mention the clamp.
acceptance_criteria: Reply icon opacity uses 36.0 as divisor
App text scaler incorporates OS accessibility preference as a dampened multiplier, clamped at 1.35
ZendScale.of() returns a clamped value between 0.85 and 1.3
verification: cd zendapp && flutter analyze lib/src/features/dm/dm_message_bubble.dart lib/app.dart lib/src/design/zend_tokens.dart
